description: This file defines a TypeScript interface for reading files, including methods for selecting files, reading a file with chunk processing, checking availability, and retrieving maximum file size.

methods.name: selectFiles(): Promise<File[]> selectFiles
methods.description: Promisified method to open a file selection dialog and return an array of selected File objects.

methods.name: readFile(file: File, minimumChunkSize: number, onChunk: OnChunkCallbackNoProgress): Promise<Fi/ readFile
methods.description: Reads a file with a specified minimum chunk size, invoking a callback for each chunk, and returns a promise of a response object.

methods.name: available(): boolean available
methods.description: Returns a boolean indicating whether the file reader is available for use.

methods.name: maximumFileSize(): number | undefined maximumFileSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum file size supported, or undefined if unlimited or not specified.

ctags.name: readFile
ctags.pattern: /^  readFile(file: File, minimumChunkSize: number, onChunk: OnChunkCallbackNoProgress): Promise<Fi/
